description: 수동 이미지 전환의 현재 선택 검증에서 자동 조건 컷 우선 선택을 생략하도록 mode3 지정

contract.mode0: Fresh rendering still selects the lowest matching configured cut; unchanged.
contract.mode1: Cycles among all existing eligible active paths with original IDs; unchanged.
contract.mode2: Returns the saved already-rendered path even if the candidate was removed or became ineligible; called before validation and unchanged.
contract.mode3: Existing jo9_path fallthrough when mode is neither 0, 1 nor 2: discovers and filters candidates, keeps the current eligible selection, otherwise normalizes to A or first surviving path, updates choice and image count, and does not automatically prefer a configured cut or advance.
contract.whySafe: The full current jo9_path has only mode2 early return and mode1 increment. Generated conditions add only a mode0 preference. Thus mode3 uses the same candidate and fallback logic while bypassing precisely that preference. With no configured rules, mode0 and mode3 run identical branches.

rootCause: Real jo9_toggle first invokes jo9_path to normalize selection. Its implicit mode0 now forces B, so a previous C differs from normalized B and the following mode1 advance is skipped. Explicit mode3 avoids the automatic preference during this manual validation step.

expectedNativeChecks.expected: Initial auto B -> manual C -> D -> A -> B.
Initial auto B -> manual C -> D -> A -> B; lowest matching rule still wins only fresh mode0 rendering.

expectedNativeChecks.case: Current B becomes ineligible before click; A/C/D survive
expectedNativeChecks.expected: mode2 identifies rendered B; mode3 falls back to A, saved-ID difference skips mode1, and HTML changes B to A. Next click advances to C.

expectedNativeChecks.case: Current C remains eligible but B becomes eligible
expectedNativeChecks.expected: Manual click advances from C to D; a fresh mode0 render still auto-selects B.
mode2 identifies the old rendered path; mode3 uses unchanged A/first-survivor fallback and HTML replacement can find the old path.

expectedNativeChecks.case: A absent but another eligible file survives
expectedNativeChecks.expected: Unchanged first-surviving-path fallback and its existing selection ID.

expectedNativeChecks.case: Registered legacy candidate uses compact ID 1 rather than 10002
expectedNativeChecks.expected: Original registered IDs remain intact through validation, cycling and mode2 lookup.
Original jo9_toggle overlay removal/rebuild and last matching attribute replacement remain unchanged.

limits: Static checks do not establish engine correctness; root must run the original jo9_html/jo9_toggle pipeline against an isolated candidate before claiming the fix passes.
If zero active paths remain, this proposal retains the existing base-path return behavior; it does not add a new fallback contract.
